question: Our brain mainly depends on which of the following food?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Only glucose.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Glucose is the primary energy source for the brain**, which needs it to function.
 
• This common simple sugar is transported throughout the body via the** bloodstream where it is then used as fuel by tissue cells.**
 
• **Vitamin C promotes general brain health **and aids in preventing damage to brain cells. In fact, a study revealed that** vitamin C may help stave off Alzheimer's.**
 
• The chemical formula for **glucose is C6H12O6.** It is the main free sugar present in higher animals' blood and can be found in fruits and honey. It is the **source of energy for cellular activity,** hence controlling its metabolism is crucial. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​​You obtain **fats as a type of nutrition from your food**. While eating certain fats is necessary, eating too much can be unhealthy.
 
• Since it was shown that the **amino acids from consumed protein** could be** turned into glucose**, there has been interest in how** proteins or amino acids** affect glucose metabolism for at least a century.
 
• After being broken down into** fatty acids, fats are use**d as a source of energy. Although protein can be used for energy, its primary function is in the** synthesis of hormones, muscle, and other proteins**. Cells use** glucose, **which is broken down, as an **energy source.** The** liver stores surplus. **
